func removeInactives(pkgs models.WordPressPackages) (removed models.WordPressPackages) {
	for _, p := range pkgs {
		if p.Status == "inactive" {
			continue
		}
		removed = append(removed, p)
	}
	return removed
}

	if ok {

	}
	return "", false
}

item.text: The scan currently reads the global `WpIgnoreInactive` flag, while the model layer already uses the server-specific `WordPress.IgnoreInactive` setting. I’m aligning the scan with the per-server setting and changing `searchCache` to accept a map value, with an explicit nil-value miss case.

item.text:
Updated [wordpress.go](/app/wordpress/wordpress.go) so `searchCache` takes a map directly, treats missing or empty values as cache misses, and package filtering reads `WordPress.IgnoreInactive` from the server’s configuration. Existing inactive filtering removes packages with `Status == "inactive"` and retains active packages.

Updated the cache tests for the new function signature. `go test ./wordpress` passes.
